decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;HB2025008-HB01&nbsp;Rev P01; HB2025008-HB02 Rev P01; HB2025008-HB03 Rev P01; HB2025008-HB04 Rev P01; HB2025008-HB05 Rev P01; HB2025008-HB06 Rev P01; HB2025008-HB07&nbsp;Rev P01; HB2025008-HB08 Rev P01; HB2025008-HB011 Rev P01; Site Location Plan; Fire Safety Statement; Flood Risk Assessment ref: LE2026070FRA dated January 2026, Flood Risk Statement
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p class="MsoNormal"><span lang="EN-US">The
development of any building hereby permitted shall not progress beyond damp proof course until the following Flood
Mitigation Measures have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local
Planning Authority, t</span>o ensure
that the structure is designed to mitigate the effects of any possible flooding
on site or elsewhere and include resistance and resilience to flooding.</p><p class="MsoNormal">



</p><p class="MsoNormal"><span lang="EN-US">The
applicant should provide detailed description of building materials,
foundations, floor, wall, fittings, services, doors and windows that minimize
water entry whilst maintaining structural integrity, materials and construction
techniques that facilitate drying and cleaning, in line with 'Improving the
Flood Performance of New Buildings' publication taking into account the
expected depth of flooding.</span><o:p></o:p></p>

The window(s) in the first floor return flank elevation(s) of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
description: Single storey front extension incorporating porch; two storey side to rear extension; single storey rear extension; external alterations (demolition of attached garage)
